patterns.note: Full-width sections with distinct background treatments (white, dark canvas, textured green/yellow) contain content centered within a consistent maximum-width container.
Key headings and phrases are emphasized with a vibrant, opaque yellow highlight, drawing immediate attention to critical information.
A high-contrast palette of black and white is accented by a vibrant red for CTAs and a distinctive bright yellow for text highlights and section backgrounds.
A dynamic, generative canvas animation serves as a continuous background element in the hero section, providing subtle, non-distracting movement.
The primary navigation bar remains fixed at the top of the viewport, ensuring constant access to site navigation as the user scrolls.
The page structure uses alternating background colors and textures for major sections, creating clear visual breaks and a sense of progression down the page.

technique_notes: The site uses a full-width layout with content centered within a fixed maximum width, creating clear visual boundaries for information.
Key textual elements are highlighted using a vibrant, opaque background color, visually separating them from surrounding text and drawing focus.
A persistent, abstract canvas animation is integrated into the hero section's background, providing a subtle, continuous visual interest that scrolls beneath the main content.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (up to ~3-4x body size) provide strong hierarchy, complemented by a clean, readable body text.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding on interactive elements like buttons, otherwise sharp corners dominate the overall design.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and within the hero, creating a sense of openness.

standout: The distinctive use of a bright, almost neon yellow highlight for key text elements, combined with a continuously animating, abstract canvas background in the hero, creates a modern and energetic feel that avoids generic corporate aesthetics. This visual emphasis on specific text is highly effective.
